A_gateLanguageAndFreeze.verbatim: C5 HARD GATE (frozen transition rule): C5 remains CLOSED until C4 is implemented, locally certified, pushed as authorized, deployed, observed end-to-end on the LIVE site, live defects resolved, and founder declares C4 certified/closed. E_F_dependencyTestPerUnit.method: Each finding was tested against RC-C5's frozen scope by its ACTUAL touch surface in code, not by title or by axis membership. Chronology alone was not treated as exempting (bifurcated clause 5).

units.title: No magic-byte/signature validation anywhere
units.touches: aura-backend confirmUpload / content-truth.ts — server-side verification of stored bytes
units.reason: A server-side signature check on a stored object is not a composer, a paste handler, a client upload pipeline, or official designation. RC-C5's VALIDATE step is the composer's readiness validation, not R2 byte verification.

units.title: Size limits advisory, not enforced
units.touches: presign content-length-range and confirmUpload reconciliation — server-side

units.title: Correspondence-messages path bypasses /media/presign entirely
units.touches: aura-backend src/messages/messages.service.ts — creates Media at status=READY from a client-supplied storageKey with no MIME check, no size check, no HEAD verification and no proof the caller owns the key
units.reason: This is a SERVER endpoint accepting an unverified key. RC-C5's 'eleven upload pipelines' are CLIENT pipelines under DR3. Closing a server-side authorization hole neither modifies nor crosses a composition surface.
units.constraintThatBinds: CO-RC-C5-019 / CO-RC-C5-020 (preserve) — the fix must not break supported content behaviour or attachment/media capabilities.

units.title: Presign body unvalidated; PresignDto dead code
units.reason: A server DTO binding. No composition surface.

units.title: Duration unit mismatch — Media.duration is ms, MessageAttachment.durationSec is seconds
units.touches: aura-backend src/messages/messages.service.ts:238 (seconds written into a ms field) and :752 (ms read back as seconds)
units.reason: A server-side unit error in a wire projection. Not a composer, not intake.

units.title: Media.aiFlags is client-writable and read by nothing
units.touches: aura-backend media.service.ts updateMetadata — aiFlags is assigned WITHOUT the allowUnsafeFields worker gate that protects every neighbouring processed field
units.reason: A server authorization gap on a PATCH endpoint.
units.severityCorrection: The finding says aiFlags is 'read by nothing'. That understates it: media.service.ts:512 writes { contentTruthRejection: reason } INTO aiFlags. A client can therefore forge or erase the record of its own content-truth rejection. Recorded as new evidence against F134; the finding is NOT re-stated or promoted.

units.title: Falsified content provenance — every conversation attachment labelled GALLERY
units.touches: the CONVERSATION COMPOSER — clipboard pastes and desktop drops are labelled source:'GALLERY' despite AttachmentSource supporting paste/upload
units.reason: This is per-composer PASTE/CLIPBOARD handling and the SELECT/PASTE/DROP head of the Attachment Lifecycle — both explicitly inside RC-C5's frozen scope (DR3, 'per-composer paste/clipboard handling (25 files)'). Bifurcated clause 4 applies: later work that MODIFIES a boundary inside the frozen gate remains gated.

units.title: Wire-kind inconsistency between canonical wireKind and conversation_screen
units.touches: canonical wireKind (backend vocabulary) AND conversation_screen (composer surface)
units.existedInRcC5ScopeAtFreeze: PARTIALLY — the conversation_screen side is a composer surface inside the frozen scope; the canonical vocabulary side is not.
units.reason: Two independent reasons to leave it alone: its composer half is inside the frozen gate, AND it is a PRESERVED CONFLICT. CH-11's own certification requirement states the dispute 'is not resolved by agreement'. This adjudication does not touch F122 in either direction.

units.title: Honest document/media formats
units.touches: spans backend type resolution AND presentation of the resolved kind
units.reason: The presentation half is a CH-11 NON-GOAL (owned by CH-13) and the composer-facing half sits inside the frozen scope. The backend type-resolution half is ungated, but it is not executed in this unit because it is not required by the security head and executing it would blur the boundary this adjudication just drew.

G_consumeVersusCross.verdict: The ungated portion CONSUMES RC-C5's preserve constraints; it does not modify or cross an unresolved RC-C5-governed boundary.
G_consumeVersusCross.keyEvidence: CH-11's ONLY two RC-C5-chartered obligations are CO-RC-C5-019 ('supported content behaviour') and CO-RC-C5-020 ('attachment/media capabilities'). BOTH come from RC-C5.originalScope.PRESERVE — scopeArea 'preserve', obligationType CHARTERED_SCOPE. Neither is a construction deliverable awaiting RC-C5's transition.
G_consumeVersusCross.doctrineApplied: The frozen completion distinction ACTIVE_CONSTRAINT != DISCHARGED_OBLIGATION. A preserve obligation BINDS whoever works in the territory; it does not GATE them. Reading a preserve constraint as a gate would make RC-C5 govern every future change to anything it ever promised not to break — precisely the retroactive platform-wide gate the bifurcated ruling forbids.
G_consumeVersusCross.notBroadened: RC-C5 was not broadened merely because CH-11 depends on something RC-C5 touched — the two preserve constraints are honoured, not ignored.
G_consumeVersusCross.notNarrowed: RC-C5 was not narrowed merely because CH-11 was architected later — F123 and F122's composer half are held GATED on their actual touch surface, despite both belonging to the later §12 axis.
